title: Hur aa raha hai Akbar
body:
Hur ibn e riyahi, aaja mere bhai..(2)
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehmaan ko hamare..(2) khaime mein leke aao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khud yaad hoga usko paani tha usne roka
khuddar wo bohot hai sharminda humse hoga
pyaase hai saare bachhe, usko na ye batao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dekho woh chal raha hai maidaa'n mein ladkhada kar
girne se pehle akbar, usko sambhalo jaakar
aye mere shahzade, jaldi qadam badhao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Abbas apne dil se, har baat saaf kardo
maa Fatima ke sadqe, hur ko muaaf kardo
jakar alam ke usko, saaye mein leke aao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Beta hussain qaidi, kaise kisiko dekhe
meri taraf se kholo, tum uske haaath jaake
baba khafa nahi hai, jaakar use batao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tum se bhi pehle marne, jaega uska beta
jee bhar ke dekhle wo, apne pisar ka chehra
kam waqt reh gaya hai, jaakar use batao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Taa hashr ye karimi, sab yaad hi rakhenge
mehmaan ka paseena khud saaf hum karenge
fizza hamari maa ka rumaal leke aao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jis dum suni ali ki beti ne ye sadaein
aasu bahake usko, dene lagi duaein
bachho'n se phir ye boli, hur ko gale lagao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Maa Fatima ke lab par uske liye dua hai
ghurbat mein usne hum par ehsaan kar diya hai
Hur ke ghulam ko bhi , izzat se leke aao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Sajjad kya bayaa'n ho kehti thi bint e zahra
bhai ki jaa'n bachane ek aur habib aaya
mera salaam fizza pohchake usko aao
<<MINI>>
Hur aa raha hai akbar, seene use lagao..(2)
